notes: Run of 2026-11-13. Three SFist stories read: the Lego resale store on Clement earns an entry. The SFPD pursuit and Union Square tree stories name no address.

findings.description: The Missing Brick, a Lego resale shop, plans to open in spring 2027 at 843 Clement Street, the storefront previously occupied by Apple Land Produce.

citation.label: SFist, “SF’s First Lego Resale Store Is Coming to Clement Street This Spring,” 12 November 2026

raw.text: The Missing Brick plans to open in spring 2027 at 843 Clement Street, which was previously occupied by Apple Land Produce.

resolution.method: EAS exact match on 843 CLEMENT ST → parcel 1441030; sf-parcels has blklot 1441030 active, 837–843 CLEMENT; the 2025 roll records it as commercial retail, built 1912. EAS puts 837, 841, 843 CLEMENT ST on that parcel, so per the directory contract the fact belongs on one page at the lowest, 837.

publish.note: Entry on the existing page /san-francisco/inner-richmond/clement-street/837/ (843 Clement resolves to the parcel's lowest number, 837) and card on the homepage grid. The couple behind the business are named in the article and recorded nowhere.
